description: Keyless web search using You.com's free MCP server. Provides basic web search capabilities without requiring API authentication, ideal for development and testing environments.

parsed_description.main: Search the web using You.com's search engine with basic results and snippets. Free tier with rate limits and reduced features.
parsed_description.args: query: The search query string. count: Optional number of results to return (default 5, max 10 in free tier).
parsed_description.returns: SearchResponse object containing web results with titles, URLs, and snippets
parsed_description.raises: You.com API errors for invalid queries, rate limits exceeded, or service issues

count.description: Number of results to return (1-10, free tier limit)
count.title: Count
